LESSON: THE RIGHTLY GUIDED CALIPHS 16

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: The Rightly Guided Caliphs 16

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Rightly Guided Caliphs 16
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain The Rightly Guided Caliphs 16 in simple words
2. give school examples of good citizenship
3. practise one responsible action

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ The Rightly Guided Caliphs 16

Teach
• A good citizen follows rules, respects others, and cares for shared places.
• Rights come with responsibilities.

Worked example
• School example: lining up quietly for assembly.
• School example: putting litter in the bin.
• Home example: telling the truth to parents.
• Community example: helping an elderly neighbour carry shopping.

Try this
• List 3 good-citizen actions at school.
• List 2 actions that are NOT good citizenship.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Lining up
• Telling truth
• Keeping compound clean

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Role-play a good citizen vs a bad choice. Discuss why.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a “Good Citizen” poster with 5 bullet points.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Respect + responsibility + honesty

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
